title: CX Analyst & Product Insights  (B2C, Tier-1) (GB04)
description:
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
  

We’re building a central Design Thinking function at Bajaj Finance - a team that will play a defining role as the organisation pivots into a direct-to-consumer company. This role sits at the intersection of data and human understanding, and thrives in that grey zone.

You’ll be the person who can stare at a funnel and see a human story. Who can sit with a field research readout and spot what’s missing. Who treats data not as an answer, but as a better question - and turns both into something the team can act on.

**What Your Work Looks Like-**

**You’ll operate across the Design Thinking lifecycle — from signal to solution:**

* Insight & Evidence: Journey analytics, Mining session replays, heatmaps, and behavioural data to surface where customers struggle and why. You bring statistical rigour — you know the difference between a pattern and noise, between correlation and causation, and you know when to trust the data and when to trust instinct.
* Challenge & Synthesis: You consume field research from dedicated research teams and stress-test it. You triangulate digital signals against qualitative findings, competitive benchmarks, and business metrics to build problem statements that hold up under scrutiny. You craft How Might We statements from clustered signals — framing the right questions that give the team a clear direction to solve against.
* Prototyping & Testing: You participate in solutioning — helping the team move from problem to prototype, designing tests, and closing the loop between what was hypothesised and what customers actually do.

**What Makes Someone Right for This-**

* 4–8 years in consumer insights, CX analytics, product analytics, UX research, or a similar role in B2C or consumer-facing companies, where you’ve worked across quantitative and qualitative inputs
* Comfortable in analytics platforms — session replay, web/app analytics, funnel analysis, segmented and cohort analysis. Can layer behavioural data over system-of-record data to move beyond surface-level insights. Specific tools matter less than your ability to get depth from any tool quickly
* Understands statistical thinking — hypothesis testing, significance, when to apply rigour and when to move on intuition
* Can read, challenge, and build on qualitative research even if you’re not the one conducting it — you know what good methodology looks like and can spot when a finding is thin
* Structures findings into clear, concise arguments. You’ve presented to senior stakeholders and know the difference between showing data and making a case
* Thinks in systems — you connect a drop-off at step 3 to an upstream design choice, a policy constraint, and a downstream business metric without being told to
* SQL-literate — you can pull what you need or speak to data teams in their language
* Brings critical reasoning that stress-tests assumptions rather than confirming them

Requirements
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  
  

* Strong Consumer Insights / CX Analytics / Product Insights profile (behavioral/user/product/UX analytics)
* Mandatory (Experience 1) - Must have 4+ years of experience in Customer Experience (CX) Analytics, Consumer Insights, Product Analytics, Behavioral Analytics, or UX Analytics, working on B2C digital products (Web/App) with a focus on understanding customer behavior, customer journeys, and experience improvement.
* Mandatory (Experience 2) - Must have hands-on experience analyzing customer journeys, behavioral funnels, digital interactions, session-level behavior, clickstream data, and experience metrics to identify pain points, drop-offs, and optimization opportunities.
* Mandatory (Experience 3) - Must have experience using CX and Digital Experience Analytics platforms such as Medallia, ContentSquare, Google Analytics (GA4) or similar tools for customer behavior analysis, journey mapping, and insight generation.
* Mandatory (Experience 4) - Must have experience working closely with Product, Design, CX, Business, Marketing, and Research teams to generate insights, validate hypotheses, and drive customer experience improvements.
* Mandatory (Experience 5 ) - Strong working knowledge of SQL and Python for data extraction, querying, analysis, exploratory data analysis, automation, and behavioral data interpretation. Ability to independently analyze large datasets, identify patterns, and generate actionable business insights.
* Mandatory (Experience 6): Understanding of hypothesis-driven thinking and basic experimentation/A/B testing concepts, including interpreting results and distinguishing between correlation and causation.
* Mandatory (Age)—The candidate's age should be below 28 years
* Preferred ( Experience 1) - Candidates from product-based companies (B2C preferred) OR Data Analytics Service companies like Mu Sigma etc

Experience: 3–6 years · Work from office · 5 days a week + alternate Saturdays · Notice period up to 30 days

Benefits
  
  

Our people define our passion and our audacious, incredibly rewarding achievements. Bajaj Finance Limited is one of India’s most diversified Non-banking financial companies, and among Asia’s top 10 Large workplaces. If you have the drive to get ahead, we can help find you an opportunity at any of the 500+ locations we’re present in India.

title: Senior Technical Support Consultant
description:
**About Armor Defense Inc**
At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we’re looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team.
  
  
Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor.
  
  
Learn more at: https://www.armor.com
  
  
**Summary**
The Technical Program Manager owns Armor’s problem-management program and the analytical work that drives down the volume of issues customers experience. This is a program and analysis role, not a day-to-day ticket-resolution role: rather than working individual customer tickets, the Technical Program Manager digs into the data behind them to find the systemic problems that generate recurring work, and drives those to permanent resolution or a clear, repeatable framework. That work is grounded in understanding how data flows into Armor’s systems—the connectors, APIs, and ingestion pipelines behind platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender—so root causes and data-quality issues can be identified, not guessed. The role partners closely with Engineering, SRE, and support delivery teams and thinks in terms of measurable, repeatable outcomes rather than one-off fixes—an approach that matters deeply for a cybersecurity company where recurring problems carry real customer risk. Based in Pune, India, the role works primarily on India business hours and carries the flexibility to overlap with US Central hours as needed to collaborate with Armor’s Dallas-based Engineering, SRE, and delivery teams. It reports to and takes strategic direction from the Head of Global Support.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Analyze incident and ticket data to identify the systemic drivers of ticket volume, and target measurable reductions in recurring work and customer-impacting incidents.
* Investigate how data flows into Armor’s systems—connectors, APIs, and ingestion pipelines from Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Qualys/VMDR, log/SIEM sources, and Azure and cloud telemetry—to surface data-quality issues and the root causes behind recurring problems.
* Work through ambiguity: develop hypotheses about recurring and systemic problems, validate root cause with data, and ensure problems are genuinely understood before solutions are pursued.
* Consolidate recurring incidents and service requests into managed problem records and drive them to permanent resolution or a clear, repeatable framework—without taking over day-to-day ticket execution, which is owned by dedicated delivery teams.
* Build the queries, dashboards, and reports that surface trends and quantify customer and business impact (e.g., KQL over Sentinel/Defender, SQL, Power BI, and Jira reporting).
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for major and recurring problems; document root causes, workarounds, and known errors so delivery teams resolve recurrences consistently.
* Partner with Engineering, SRE, and delivery teams to land systemic fixes, and coordinate permanent fixes that require change through Armor’s change process.
* Define and report the metrics that matter—reduction in recurring customer-impacting incidents and ticket volume as the headline, with operational signals (recurring-problem count, MTTR, RCA compliance, and SLA adherence) as supporting measures.
* Run problem-review cadences, maintain and drive down a prioritized problem backlog, and track held known errors so workarounds do not quietly become permanent technical debt.
* Identify automation and process-improvement opportunities and program-manage their delivery to reduce manual, repetitive work.
* Maintain authoritative documentation and a known-error knowledge base in Confluence, and provide clear, executive-level status, risks, and escalations.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10-12 years of experience in technical program management, security or IT operations, data and analytics, or service/problem management; Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven ability to manage cross-functional programs and drive outcomes across multiple teams without direct authority.
* Hands-on data analysis: able to query operational and security data using KQL (Microsoft Sentinel/Defender) and SQL, and to build reports and dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Jira) that surface trends and quantify impact.
* Working understanding of data integrations—connectors, APIs, and ingestion pipelines—and how security telemetry reaches a SIEM or analytics platform (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender).
* Solid grounding in problem management and root cause analysis, aligned to ITIL (Problem, Incident, and Service Management).
* Familiarity (conceptual, not hands-on delivery) with the security domains Armor operates: vulnerability management (Qualys/VMDR), endpoint and EDR (Microsoft Defender), and cloud and identity (Azure, Okta/Entra).
* Ability to read incident and ticket data and translate it into prioritized, measurable action.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management in English, including executive-level reporting and clear RCAs and resolution frameworks.
* Proficiency with Jira and Confluence.
* Strategic, systemic thinker with a bias for repeatable, automation-assisted solutions over one-off fixes.
* Self-directed, taking strategic direction and prioritization from the Head of Support.

****Alignment to Armor Core Values****

* COMMITMENT TO GROWTH
* INTEGRITY ALWAYS
* EMPATHY IN ACTION
* IMMEDIATE IMPACT
* FOLLOW-THROUGH

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Depth in KQL/Kusto, Power BI, or Power Automate, or exposure to data engineering and pipeline troubleshooting.
* Experience building or troubleshooting API-based integrations and data connectors.
* PMP, ITIL v4, or Microsoft security/Azure certifications.
* Experience in a cybersecurity or managed-security services (MSSP) environment.

title: Technology and Innovation - Data Engineering Manager
description:
**Data Engineering Manager**
Riveron is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to be part of our data engineering team in India. This is not a pure people-management role — you will be writing code, building pipelines, and architecting data platforms daily alongside your team. We're looking for someone who leads from the codebase, not just from a conference room. If you bring deep implementation experience across Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks and can pair strong architectural thinking with real delivery output, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* A data engineering professional with 8 to 12 years of experience, including 1-3 years balancing technical leadership with active, hands-on implementation — you've managed teams without stepping away from the keyboard.
* You write production-quality code daily. This role requires active coding and pipeline development — not just code reviews and architectural diagrams.
* Hands-on, implementation-level expertise with Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks is non-negotiable. You've personally built, deployed, and tuned production workloads on these platforms.
* Strong data architecture background spanning lakehouse design, medallion architecture, data vault, dimensional modeling, and enterprise data platform design — grounded in systems you've actually built, not just designed on paper.
* Deep proficiency in SQL and Python — you can write complex transformations, optimize query performance, debug pipeline failures, and build automation frameworks yourself.
* Proven experience building and shipping ETL/ELT frameworks using Azure Data Factory, dbt, Spark, and platform-native orchestration tools.
* Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud data services (Synapse Analytics, Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL Database) and comfort operating in multi-cloud environments.
* Well-versed in data governance, data quality frameworks, cataloging, lineage, and security best practices — with experience implementing these controls, not just defining policies.
* Proficient with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines for data workloads, and Infrastructure as Code — you commit code, open pull requests, and maintain deployment pipelines alongside your team.
* Comfortable working in Agile delivery environments and translating business requirements into scalable technical designs.

**What You'll Do**

* Spend a significant portion of your time writing code — building data pipelines, developing transformation logic, configuring platform services, and shipping production-ready solutions.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers while remaining the team's strongest technical contributor and setting the standard through your own code and architectural decisions.
* Design and personally implement scalable data platforms on Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks — selecting the right platform for each use case and building the solution end to end.
* Architect and build lakehouse and data warehouse solutions, defining and coding ingestion patterns, transformation layers, storage strategies, and consumption models.
* Own critical and complex implementation work — the toughest pipeline builds, the most challenging performance problems, and the architectural spikes that set direction for the team.
* Write and maintain shared libraries, frameworks, and reusable components that accelerate the team's delivery and enforce engineering standards.
* Conduct deep, line-level code reviews focused on correctness, performance, and maintainability — not just approval stamps.
* Partner with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into engineered solutions and personally prototype key components.
* Establish and enforce best practices for data modeling, pipeline reliability, observability, testing, and documentation — by building the reference implementations yourself.
* Optimize platform performance and manage costs across Snowflake compute, Databricks clusters, and Fabric capacities through hands-on tuning and configuration.
* Implement data governance and security controls across engineering initiatives, ensuring compliance, data quality, and lineage traceability at the code and platform level.
* Stay current with the evolving data platform landscape and evaluate emerging tools through hands-on proof-of-concept work, not just vendor demos.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A career path that shows sustained, hands-on implementation even as responsibilities grew — architect-turned-manager, not analyst-turned-manager.
* Hands-on experience building medallion-architecture lakehouses on Databricks or Microsoft Fabric, and designing and tuning performant Snowflake warehouse structures.
* Experience implementing CI/CD for data pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including writing the pipeline definitions and deployment scripts yourself.
* Familiarity with dbt for transformation orchestration, with personal experience writing and maintaining dbt models and tests.
* Exposure to real-time or near-real-time data ingestion patterns (Kafka, Event Hubs, Spark Structured Streaming) through direct implementation.
* Experience with data mesh or domain-oriented data platform strategies is a strong plus.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate architectural trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience running sprint planning, design reviews, and cross-functional delivery coordination.

**About CloudLex**

CloudLex is a leading cloud based legal technology platform for litigation firms in the United States. Attorneys, paralegals, and case managers use it every day to run complex cases from beginning to end. Headquartered in New York, with engineering, product, and marketing in Pune, India. Reaching 300 professionals globally. Backed by prestigious venture capital and growth private equity, including Aligned Capital, Rosepark Advisors, and The Riverside Company.

**The Role**

You work directly with our Chief Technology Officer, and you are the person who makes product development run.

You will be on client calls, sales calls, and customer success calls, hearing what law firms in the United States actually need rather than reading somebody’s summary of it. You turn what you hear into the product roadmap and the development plan. You track what is being built, hold the priorities when everything is urgent, and you are the person who can say at any moment what is coming next, what it depends on, and why it is in that order.

Think of it as being the champion of product development from the management side. The engineers build. You make sure the right things get built, in the right order, for reasons the whole company can see.

**Work with the CTO**

* Build and maintain the product roadmap and keep it current
* Turn the roadmap into development plans engineering can actually work from
* Track what is in flight: what is on time, what has slipped, what is blocked and on whom
* Hold the priority when everything is urgent, and be able to defend why something did not make it

**Be in the room with clients**

* Join client calls, sales, and customer success calls, and listen for the problem underneath the request
* Work with the Customer Success and Sales in the United States as a direct partner, not through a relay
* Turn what clients tell you into clear needs, with the reasoning attached so engineering knows why
* Say when something should not be built, and say it to the person who asked for it

**Articulate the development path**

* Make it clear across the company what is being built, when, and why, so nobody has to ask
* Define what the software does in the normal case and in every case that is not normal
* For AI features, define what the user sees, what gets cited, where a person reviews before anything is final, and what happens when the model is wrong
* Work with design on how it should feel, not only on what it should do

**Use AI as your main instrument**

* Analyze usage data, support tickets, and call transcripts at volume using AI, then verify what it told you
* Draft with AI and then interrogate what it produced, because a confident answer and a correct answer look the same
* Build evaluation sets that prove an AI feature is accurate before it reaches a real case file
* Know what these tools are bad at and stop using them there

**What we need from you**

* We care about how you reason, not what your degree says
* 3-5 years in a role where you had a say in what got built, not only in documenting it
* Experience as a product owner or product champion, meaning you owned what got built and why. Running the backlog and the ceremonies around it is not the same thing and does not count here
* Any background. Engineering, an MBA in IT or systems, economics, statistics, consulting.
* Comfort being client facing. You will be on calls with US cients/teams
* Daily, practical use of AI tools in your own analytical work. Not awareness. Use
* Comfort with data. You do not need SQL. You do need to be the kind of person who asks for the numbers before forming a view, and who can get to them with whatever tools are available
* Written clarity. Much of your work reaches people in another country who cannot ask you a follow-up question in the corridor

**Useful, not required**

* Enterprise or B2B software, especially where the users are professionals whose work carries real consequences
* Exposure to AI products and what goes wrong with them
* Experience working across time zones

description:
As a Senior Digital Marketing Executive at DNKR Digital, you will take complete ownership of end-to-end digital marketing campaigns, acting as both a strategist and an execution lead to drive substantial business growth for our clients. Working closely with our industry veteran founder, your day-to-day responsibilities will span across multiple high-impact domains:

1. **Website Creation & Optimization:** Oversee end-to-end website development, monitor UX/UI improvements, design high-converting landing pages, and ensure optimal technical performance and speed.
2. **Search Optimization (SEO, AEO, GEO):** Spearhead organic visibility strategies. This includes traditional Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) tailored for AI-driven search and chatbots like ChatGPT and Perplexity, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
3. **Paid Advertising (Google & Meta Ads):** Plan, execute, optimize, and scale performance marketing campaigns across Google (Search, Display, YouTube) and Meta (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn) to maximize ROI.
4. **Social Media Marketing:** Formulate comprehensive social media strategies, oversee content creation, manage community interactions, and build a strong organic brand presence across channels.
5. **Lead Generation & Funnel Optimization:** Design, implement, and track end-to-end lead generation funnels, manage capture forms, and execute conversion rate optimization (CRO) tactics.
6. **Email Marketing & Automation:** Build and manage sophisticated email campaigns, including newsletters, drip sequences, customer segmentation, and automated workflow triggers.
7. **Strategy & Decision Making:** Formulate comprehensive digital growth strategies, manage campaign budgets effectively, and utilize tools like Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Looker Studio, Semrush, Ahrefs, and Zoho/HubSpot CRM to make data-backed business decisions.
8. **Client Handling & Account Management:** Serve as the primary point of contact for key clients, present performance reports, understand business objectives, and cultivate long-term client relationships.
9. **Client Visits & Field Coordination:** Conduct 6 to 8 in-person client meetings per month across Pune to align on strategies, present deliverables, and provide strategic advisory.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a dynamic, results-driven professional who matches the following criteria:

* **Experience:** Minimum 5+ years of hands-on, full-funnel digital marketing experience, preferably within a fast-paced agency or startup environment.
* **Location & Mobility:** Based in Pune or actively open to relocating to Pune. You must be comfortable working remotely (WFH) while maintaining the mobility required for 68 monthly client visits across the city.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Deep working knowledge of industry-standard tools including Google Ads Manager, Meta Ads Manager, GA4, GTM, Semrush, Ahrefs, WordPress, Elementor, Mailchimp/HubSpot, and Canva/Figma.
* **Communication & Interpersonal Skills:** Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills, with a proven track record of handling client-facing discussions with confidence, poise, and professionalism.
* **Work Ethic & Flexibility:** Available Monday to Friday (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM), with occasional flexibility required for a 2–3 hour commitment on Saturdays when urgent client meetings or reviews demand it.

**Perks and Benefits**

Joining DNKR Digital offers a unique blend of startup agility and mentorship from a 20+ year industry veteran:

* **Competitive Compensation:** Earn a stable salary of up to 6,00,000 per annum, commensurate with your experience and capability to scale campaigns.
* **Flexibility of Remote Work:** Enjoy the convenience of a Work From Home (WFH) arrangement that eliminates daily commuting stress while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
* **Direct Mentorship:** Work directly alongside an industry veteran with over two decades of corporate and entrepreneurial experience, accelerating your professional growth and strategic leadership skills.
* **High Ownership & Career Growth:** Take charge of diverse client portfolios across industries, giving you creative freedom, strategic decision-making power, and a clear path toward leadership roles as the startup scales.
